```{r}
#| label: prepare-data

library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(stringr)

base_url <- "https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/summary_file/2024/table-based-SF"
table_url <- paste0(base_url, "/data/5YRData/acsdt5y2024-b02001.dat")
shell_url <- paste0(base_url, "/documentation/ACS20245YR_Table_Shells.txt")
boundary_url <- "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2024/shp/cb_2024_us_county_500k.zip"
work_dir <- tempdir()
table_file <- file.path(work_dir, "acsdt5y2024-b02001.dat")
shell_file <- file.path(work_dir, "ACS20245YR_Table_Shells.txt")
boundary_file <- file.path(work_dir, "cb_2024_us_county_500k.zip")

download_if_missing <- function(url, path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) {
    curl::curl_download(url, path, quiet = TRUE)
  }
}

download_if_missing(table_url, table_file)
download_if_missing(shell_url, shell_file)
download_if_missing(boundary_url, boundary_file)

race_keys <- c("white", "black", "aian", "asian", "nhpi", "other", "two_or_more")
table_ids <- sprintf("B02001_%03d", 1:8)
estimate_columns <- paste0("B02001_E", sprintf("%03d", 1:8))
population_columns <- c("total_population", paste0(race_keys, "_population"))
percentage_columns <- paste0(race_keys, "_percent")

shell <- read_delim(
  shell_file,
  delim = "|",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
) |>
  filter(.data[["Table ID"]] == "B02001")

shell_labels <- shell$Label[match(table_ids, shell$`Unique ID`)]
expected_shell_labels <- c(
  "Total:",
  "White alone",
  "Black or African American alone",
  "American Indian and Alaska Native alone",
  "Asian alone",
  "Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone",
  "Some Other Race alone",
  "Two or More Races:"
)
if (!identical(shell_labels, expected_shell_labels)) {
  stop("The official B02001 table shell labels differ from the expected race categories.")
}

data_header <- strsplit(read_lines(table_file, n_max = 1), "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
if (!all(c("GEO_ID", estimate_columns) %in% data_header)) {
  stop("The downloaded B02001 data file does not have the expected estimate columns.")
}

census_counties <- read_delim(
  table_file,
  delim = "|",
  col_select = all_of(c("GEO_ID", estimate_columns)),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
) |>
  filter(str_starts(GEO_ID, "0500000US12"), str_length(GEO_ID) == 14) |>
  transmute(
    GEOID = str_sub(GEO_ID, -5L),
    across(all_of(estimate_columns), as.numeric)
  ) |>
  setNames(c("GEOID", population_columns))

if (nrow(census_counties) != 67L || anyDuplicated(census_counties$GEOID)) {
  stop("The official B02001 file must contain one record for each of Florida's 67 counties.")
}

utils::unzip(boundary_file, exdir = work_dir)
boundary_path <- file.path(work_dir, "cb_2024_us_county_500k.shp")
florida_boundaries <- st_read(boundary_path, quiet = TRUE) |>
  filter(STATEFP == "12") |>
  st_transform(4326)

if (nrow(florida_boundaries) != 67L || anyDuplicated(florida_boundaries$GEOID)) {
  stop("The official TIGER/Line boundaries must contain one record for each Florida county.")
}

if (!setequal(florida_boundaries$GEOID, census_counties$GEOID)) {
  stop("The Census GEOIDs do not match the Florida county boundary GEOIDs.")
}

counties <- florida_boundaries |>
  left_join(census_counties, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(population_columns), as.numeric)
  )

if (anyNA(st_drop_geometry(counties)[population_columns]) ||
    any(counties$total_population <= 0)) {
  stop("One or more Florida counties have missing or invalid population estimates.")
}

for (i in seq_along(race_keys)) {
  counties[[percentage_columns[[i]]]] <-
    counties[[paste0(race_keys[[i]], "_population")]] /
    counties$total_population * 100
}

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(st_drop_geometry(counties)[percentage_columns]))) ||
    any(abs(rowSums(st_drop_geometry(counties)[percentage_columns]) - 100) > 0.1)) {
  stop("The B02001 race percentages failed validation against total county population.")
}

map_data <- counties |>
  select(
    GEOID,
    county = NAME,
    all_of(population_columns),
    all_of(percentage_columns)
  ) |>
  st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 0.003)

geojson <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  geojsonsf::sf_geojson(map_data, factors_as_string = TRUE),
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)
map_bounds <- as.numeric(st_bbox(counties))
```

```{r}
#| label: florida-map
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: 100%

map_widget <- leaflet(
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = TRUE,
    scrollWheelZoom = TRUE,
    preferCanvas = TRUE
  )
) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var colors = ['#eff3ff', '#c6dbef', '#9ecae1', '#4292c6', '#084594'];
      var labels = {
        white: 'White alone',
        black: 'Black or African American alone',
        aian: 'American Indian and Alaska Native alone',
        asian: 'Asian alone',
        nhpi: 'Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone',
        other: 'Some other race alone',
        two_or_more: 'Two or more races'
      };
      var selected = 'white';
      var selectedCounty = null;
      var legend;
      var panel = element('aside', 'county-panel');
      panel.id = 'county-info';
      panel.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
      panel.appendChild(element('h2', '', 'Explore a county'));
      panel.appendChild(element('p', '', 'Select any county to see its population estimates and racial composition.'));
      el.appendChild(panel);
      L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(panel);
      L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(panel);
      var selector = document.getElementById('race-select');
      var measure = document.getElementById('map-measure');

      function element(tag, className, text) {
        var node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (className) node.className = className;
        if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
        return node;
      }

      function formatCount(value) {
        return Number(value).toLocaleString('en-US');
      }

      function getValues() {
        return data.geojson.features.map(function(feature) {
          return Number(feature.properties[selected + '_percent']);
        }).filter(Number.isFinite).sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
      }

      function quantile(sorted, fraction) {
        return sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(fraction * sorted.length))];
      }

      function updateLegend() {
        var values = getValues();
        var cuts = [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8].map(function(q) {
          return quantile(values, q);
        });
        var control = element('div', 'race-legend');
        control.appendChild(element('strong', '', 'County population'));
        var rows = element('div', 'legend-scale');
        colors.forEach(function(color, i) {
          var row = element('div', 'legend-row');
          var swatch = element('span', 'legend-swatch');
          swatch.style.backgroundColor = color;
          var lower = i === 0 ? 0 : cuts[i - 1];
          var upper = i === 4 ? values[values.length - 1] : cuts[i];
          row.appendChild(swatch);
          row.appendChild(element('span', '', lower.toFixed(1) + '–' + upper.toFixed(1) + '%'));
          rows.appendChild(row);
        });
        control.appendChild(rows);
        if (legend) legend.remove();
        legend = L.control({position: 'bottomright'});
        legend.onAdd = function() { return control; };
        legend.addTo(map);
      }

      function styleFeature(feature) {
        var value = Number(feature.properties[selected + '_percent']);
        var values = getValues();
        var cuts = [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8].map(function(q) {
          return quantile(values, q);
        });
        var index = cuts.findIndex(function(cut) { return value <= cut; });
        if (index < 0) index = 4;
        return {
          color: '#ffffff',
          weight: 1,
          opacity: 0.95,
          fillColor: colors[index],
          fillOpacity: 0.88
        };
      }

      function tooltip(feature) {
        var p = feature.properties;
        var box = element('div', 'county-tooltip');
        box.appendChild(element('strong', '', p.county + ' County'));
        box.appendChild(element('span', '', labels[selected]));
        box.appendChild(element('span', '', formatCount(p[selected + '_population']) + ' of ' +
          formatCount(p.total_population) + ' people'));
        box.appendChild(element('b', '', Number(p[selected + '_percent']).toFixed(1) +
          '% of county population'));
        return box;
      }

      function showCounty(feature) {
        var p = feature.properties;
        selectedCounty = feature;
        panel.replaceChildren();
        panel.appendChild(element('h2', '', p.county + ' County'));
        panel.appendChild(element('p', 'county-total', 'Total population: ' +
          formatCount(p.total_population)));
        var table = element('table', 'county-table');
        var head = element('thead');
        var header = element('tr');
        ['Race category', 'Estimate', 'Share'].forEach(function(text) {
          header.appendChild(element('th', '', text));
        });
        head.appendChild(header);
        table.appendChild(head);
        var body = element('tbody');
        Object.keys(labels).forEach(function(key) {
          var row = element('tr');
          row.appendChild(element('td', '', labels[key]));
          row.appendChild(element('td', '', formatCount(p[key + '_population'])));
          row.appendChild(element('td', '', Number(p[key + '_percent']).toFixed(1) + '%'));
          body.appendChild(row);
        });
        table.appendChild(body);
        panel.appendChild(table);
      }

      var counties = L.geoJSON(data.geojson, {
        style: styleFeature,
        onEachFeature: function(feature, layer) {
          layer.bindTooltip(tooltip(feature), {
            sticky: true,
            direction: 'top',
            className: 'race-tooltip'
          });
          layer.on({
            mouseover: function(event) {
              event.target.setStyle({weight: 2, color: '#172b4d', fillOpacity: 1});
              event.target.openTooltip();
            },
            mouseout: function(event) {
              counties.resetStyle(event.target);
              event.target.closeTooltip();
            },
            click: function() {
              showCounty(feature);
            }
          });
        }
      }).addTo(map);

      selector.addEventListener('change', function() {
        selected = selector.value;
        measure.textContent = 'Percentage of county population · ' + labels[selected];
        counties.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          layer.setStyle(styleFeature(layer.feature));
          layer.setTooltipContent(tooltip(layer.feature));
        });
        if (selectedCounty) showCounty(selectedCounty);
        updateLegend();
      });

      updateLegend();
      map.fitBounds([[data.bounds[1], data.bounds[0]], [data.bounds[3], data.bounds[2]]],
        {padding: [22, 22]});

      var reset = L.control({position: 'topleft'});
      reset.onAdd = function() {
        var button = element('button', 'reset-view', 'Reset view');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.title = 'Show all Florida counties';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(button);
        L.DomEvent.on(button, 'click', function() {
          map.fitBounds([[data.bounds[1], data.bounds[0]], [data.bounds[3], data.bounds[2]]],
            {padding: [22, 22]});
        });
        return button;
      };
      reset.addTo(map);
    }
    ",
    data = list(geojson = geojson, bounds = map_bounds)
  )

map_widget
```

<div class="map-caption">Select a race category to update the map. Hover over a county for details, or click it to compare all categories.</div>

## Data and methodology

**Source:** U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-Year Estimates, Detailed Table B02001 — Race. The estimates are downloaded from the Census Bureau's public [2024 table-based ACS Summary File](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data/summary-file.2024.html), then joined to official 2024 TIGER/Line county boundaries by five-digit county GEOID. All 67 Florida counties are included.

Each mapped value is the selected race-alone estimate divided by the county's B02001 total population estimate, multiplied by 100. ACS figures are survey estimates. Census race-alone categories describe race; Hispanic or Latino origin is a separate ethnicity classification and is not included as a mutually exclusive race category in this map.
